Lumenwise Terms of Use

Effective October 9, 2026 · Last updated October 9, 2026

In plain English: your use of Lumenwise is governed by Apple's standard app license, plus the extra terms below. AI answers in Ask are generated on your iPhone and can be wrong; they are not pastoral, medical or professional advice. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel, and a free trial turns into a paid subscription unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends.

Apple's Standard EULA

Lumenwise is licensed to you, not sold, under Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (the "Standard EULA"). The Standard EULA, including its sections on the scope of the license, consent to use of data, termination, warranty disclaimers, limitation of liability, export rules and governing law, applies to Lumenwise. These Terms of Use add app-specific terms. If these terms and the Standard EULA conflict, the Standard EULA controls, except where these terms give you more rights. We (the developer of Lumenwise), not Apple, are responsible for Lumenwise and its support. Apple is a third-party beneficiary of the Standard EULA and may enforce it.

By downloading or using Lumenwise you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the app. Our Privacy Policy explains how data is handled.

Ask and AI-generated answers

  • Ask uses Apple's on-device Foundation Models, where your iPhone supports them. Answers are generated automatically on your device; nobody reviews them, and they can be incomplete, inaccurate or worded in a way you disagree with.
  • Bible verses quoted in an answer are taken word for word from the app's built-in texts. The explanation, summary or application around them is AI-generated commentary, not Scripture, and does not represent the views of any church, denomination or of the developer.
  • Answers and built-in study notes are for personal study and reflection. They are not pastoral, theological, medical, psychological, legal or financial advice, and Ask is not a counseling or crisis service. If you are struggling or in danger, contact local emergency services, a crisis line, or someone you trust.
  • Ask is available only on supported devices and iOS versions with Apple Intelligence turned on, and Apple controls that model. We can't promise it will be available on every device or that its answers will stay the same over time.

Bible texts

Lumenwise includes the King James Version (1769 text) and the World English Bible, both public domain texts obtained from eBible.org. "World English Bible" is a trademark of eBible.org, used to identify the text; Lumenwise is not endorsed by eBible.org. In the United Kingdom, rights in the King James Version are vested in the Crown. Reading plans, devotionals and study notes in the app are provided for personal use and may not be copied out of the app in bulk.

Using Lumenwise

Lumenwise is meant for people aged 13 and older. If you are under the age of majority where you live, use it with the permission of a parent or guardian, who also agrees to these terms for purchases. Features may differ between versions and devices and may change as we improve the app.

Free version and ads

Reading both translations, search, the prayer journal and a selection of reading plans are free; other features, such as more plans, unlimited Ask questions and some exports, need Lumenwise Pro. The free version shows ads served by third-party ad networks through AppLovin MAX, only on the Plans list and in Search results, plus at most one full-screen ad per session after you complete a plan day. Ads never appear in the Bible reader text, the prayer journal, Ask, Today or verse cards. We are not responsible for the content of third-party ads or the websites or apps they link to, although we ask our ad partners to block gambling, dating and mature ads where their controls allow it. Rewarded ads may unlock a small bonus described in the app (such as extra Ask questions or a reading plan for a few days); rewards have no cash value, cannot be transferred and may change.

Lumenwise Pro: subscriptions, free trial and lifetime purchase

The free version of Lumenwise includes ads and the features described in the app as free. Lumenwise Pro unlocks the Pro features and removes ads. Pro is available as:

  • An auto-renewing subscription (yearly, and any other period offered in the app). The yearly plan may include a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, as an Apple introductory offer.
  • A lifetime purchase: a one-time, non-consumable purchase. No renewals.

The price, billing period and trial length are shown in the app before you confirm and in Apple's purchase sheet. Prices vary by country and may include taxes.

How billing works

  • Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. If you start a free trial, you are not charged during the trial; your Apple ID is charged the subscription price when the trial ends unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends.
  • Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the current period ends, at the then-current price.
  • You can manage or cancel a subscription at any time in iOS Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions, or from the "Manage subscription" option in the app's Settings. Cancelling stops future renewals; you keep Pro until the end of the period you paid for. If you cancel during a free trial, Apple may end your access to Pro right away.
  • Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription or the lifetime purchase.
  • If a price increases, Apple notifies you in advance and, where required, asks for your consent before renewing at the new price.
  • If you have a subscription and later buy the lifetime purchase, cancel the subscription in Settings so you are not charged twice. The app reminds you.
  • Purchases are shareable with up to five other family members through Apple's Family Sharing, where the app says so.

Refunds and restores

All payments are processed by Apple. We cannot see or issue refunds; request one from Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com. Apple's refund decisions and your statutory rights (for example, EU/UK withdrawal rights for digital content) are handled by Apple under its terms. Use "Restore Purchases" in the app to get Pro back on a new device signed in to the same Apple ID.

For Lumenwise, Pro is offered as Lumenwise Pro Yearly, with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, and Lumenwise Pro Lifetime, a one-time purchase. Both are shareable through Family Sharing. The current price in your currency is shown in the app and in Apple's purchase sheet before you confirm.

Your data

What you create in Lumenwise stays on your device; this version does not sync to iCloud. You are responsible for keeping your device, Apple ID and any exported files secure, and for keeping backups. We cannot recover data you delete or lose because we never have a copy.

Acceptable use

Don't use Lumenwise to break the law or anyone else's rights; don't use verse cards, shared content or read-together invites to harass anyone; don't try to reverse-engineer, tamper with or bypass the app's purchase checks or ad systems, except where the law allows this despite this restriction; and don't use automated means to generate fake ad impressions or rewards.

Disclaimers and liability

Lumenwise is provided "as is" and "as available", as described in the Standard EULA. We work to keep the Bible texts accurate, but we do not guarantee that the app, its texts, study notes or AI answers are free of errors. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for decisions you make based on the app's content, for missed notifications or reminders, or for the loss of data stored on your device, and our total liability is limited as described in the Standard EULA. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, or rights you have under consumer law in your country that cannot be waived.

Changes

We may update these terms, for example when we add features. We will change the date at the top and, for significant changes, tell you in the app. Continuing to use Lumenwise after a change means you accept the updated terms. Changes never apply retroactively to purchases you already made.
